faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: IIEST Shibpur has invited applications for 1 Junior Research Fellow post under the DAE-BNRS sponsored project titled "Adiabatic Quantum Control for Quantum Advantage" in the Department of Physics.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email is 13 October 2026 (within 2 weeks of publication of the advertisement dated 29.09.2026).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Physics or allied discipline with a minimum of 60% marks (or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale), with 55% marks (or 6.0 CGPA) for SC/ST/PwD candidates, along with a qualified GATE/NET score.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years, with relaxations up to 3 years for OBC (NCL) and up to 5 years for SC/ST, women, and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must email a single self-attested PDF containing their cover letter, CV, marksheets, and certificates to [email protected] with the subject line "APPLICATION FOR JRF-2026".

faq.question: Q8. What is the fellowship salary offered?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month for Year 1 and Year 2, and Rs. 42,000/- per month for Year 3.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications, and shortlisted applicants will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview date and time will be notified directly to the candidates via email or mobile.
